fact: After the government announced a new fuel price rise on 10 September 2026 (Super Sans Plomb to 817 FCFA), the DMK-Originale, DMP, LDP and Touche Pas A Ma Constitution movements issued a joint statement denouncing it as financial asphyxiation of households.
title: Hausse du carburant au Togo : l'opposition dénonce une « asphyxie financière » des ménages
